title: Cahn-Hilliard equation associated with hypergraph
summary: A hypergraph Laplacian was introduced to investigate the structure of networks written as hypergraphs. It was shown that the behavior of solutions to an evolution equation associated with the hypergraph Laplacian quite resembles that of solutions to the classical heat equation. Hence by replacing the Laplacian in PDEs with the hypergraph Laplacian, we might be able to introduce various diffusion models on hypergraphs (discrete domains), whose behavior of solution is similar to PDEs.
